gloss: one's personal opinion; one's own view

definitions.explanation: One's own view, offered as distinct from an official position or established fact. Used to signal modestly that what follows is only the speaker's take.

examples.japanese: {私見|しけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べます→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: I will give my personal view.

examples.japanese: ⟦あくまで→あくまで：06713_akumade⟧{私見|しけん}です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧です。
examples.english: This is only my personal opinion, but I'm against it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見解|けんかい}→見解：02743_kenkai⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{筆者|ひっしゃ}→筆者：04348_hissha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{私見|しけん}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: What follows is not the company's position but the author's personal opinion.

notes:
Composed of {私|し} (private, personal) + {見|けん} (view). Formal and written; in speech it appears mainly in meetings, lectures, and interviews as a hedge before stating an opinion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私見|しけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to state one's personal view
- ⟦あくまで→あくまで：06713_akumade⟧{私見|しけん}です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: this is purely my own opinion, but…
- {私見|しけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: in my personal view

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: opinion — the ordinary neutral word, with no hedge built in
- ⟦{見解|けんかい}→見解：02743_kenkai⟧: view, position — usually an official or considered stance, often institutional
- {所感|しょかん}: impressions, thoughts — a reflective response to an experience rather than a position on an issue
